integrity: The proof, independent finite checks by explicit valuation enumeration, literature comparisons, and source limits are stated within the package; no external independent assessment has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only finite labelled directed frames with maximum outdegree two are classified and enumerated; loops allowed, no isomorphism census.
The asymptotic establishes logarithmic growth, not a multiplicative constant or full asymptotic expansion.
The bounded checker exhausts carrier sizes one through four only; the all-size result depends on the proof.
Historical priority is provisional; older nonindexed bounded-branching enumerations could overlap.
The degree-one-successor condition was previously established for overlapping weakly transitive families; no novelty is claimed there.
title: Sharp degree-two criterion and census for finite McKinsey-valid frames
